author: trvrio
text: "HTTP2Shell" and "Node2Shell" are the same bug, CVE-2026-111497, in Google's Brotli decoder; reaches Envoy, Istio, Bun, Python Brotli and distro packages. CVSS 9.2, public PoC shown achieving RCE on Node 24.

author: Komodosec
text: CVE-2026-106173: Horizon3.ai deep-dive on the FortiSIEM gRPC path traversal file write leading to unauthenticated RCE.

author: catc0n
text: Our team got code execution working on PHP 8.2 and 8.3 today (PHP2Shell), rounding out testing across supported versions. No universal exploit, but RCE with ASLR is possible across the affected range.

author: TIE__SUN
text: UNC actors are exploiting PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618/9) against public and business infrastructure; the CVSS 9.2 bugs bypass WAFs via multipart parsing, and Mirai C2 nodes are mass-scanning for unauthenticated RCE.

author: DanteMMartin
text: Someone hid a $500 bitcoin key on an unpatched PHP server, daring the internet to exploit PHP2Shell, the RCE an OpenAI model found last week. The AI-discovered bug is now a live public bounty.

author: xmyttle
text: Critical Brotli bug CVE-2026-111497, found during AI red-teaming, can take over a Node.js server with one malicious compressed message, no login needed. Patches are out.

author: haani0090
text: The Railway attackers were hunting AI provider API keys; the breach report says the goal was distillation attacks. Railway says rotate everything if you signed up before Oct 21.

author: MDBayNews
text: Johns Hopkins Bayview exposes 3,182 patient records after an employee uploaded medical data to an unapproved AI tool.

author: BitcoinNewsEng
text: Bitcoin Core updated its disclosure policy: easily discoverable bugs, including those found with simple LLM prompts, will be fixed and advisories published immediately instead of after an embargo.

author: ManiarViral
text: LiteLLM critical CVE-2026-35029 + CVE-2026-59823: auth bypass and SSRF via unauthenticated POST to /config/update lets attackers steal downstream OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini and Bedrock keys. Patch to 1.83.9.

author: agentguardsco
text: Tencent's Corvus AI found Vghost (CVE-2026-74580): a vhost bug giving local users root across kernels 4.11-7.2. Tencent: "machine-assisted research, not an attack run by AI."

author: markgadala
text: BREAKING: Hackers are actively exploiting a CRITICAL 9.9/10 zero-day in Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator; even a READ-ONLY account can gain superuser privileges.

author: VarunChopr17597
text: Patch list: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator (on-prem) CVE-2026-114625, CVSS 9.9 SQLi zero-day exploited in the wild, CISA KEV deadline Oct 26. Fixed in 5.2.3.18.

author: drerdalozkaya
text: CISA added two actively exploited flaws to KEV: Collabora Online (CVE-2026-110447) and Arista VeloCloud (CVE-2026-114625). Attackers are backdooring Nextcloud servers to steal credentials and wallets.

author: dlt_green
text: PHP2Shell (21 Oct): CVE-2026-109618 & CVE-2026-109619 (CVSS 9.2), unauthenticated RCE in PHP core. Attackers are scanning. Patch now.

author: allday_stocks
text: Palo Alto Networks CEO warns AI-discovered PHP vulnerabilities expose widespread risk; two critical PHP flaws discovered with AI prompted government website shutdowns in the Netherlands, Finland and France.

author: JustOne4us
text: AI-found PHP flaws CVE-2026-109618 / CVE-2026-109619 forced sites offline. Patches Oct 21, exploits started Oct 17.

author: HB_CyberSec
text: CVE-2026-114612 (CVSS 9.9): LiteLLM used one salt key for stored secrets and admin sessions; replay ciphertext as Bearer to get admin, then code exec via a stdio MCP server.

author: xcademialtd
text: AWS patches a critical Python sandbox escape vulnerability in its MCP Server.

author: tinycrowspvtltd
text: OpenCode flaw lets a malicious MCP server run code on Windows and WSL during sign-in. Rated 9.8, no CVE. Fixed in 1.18.33.

author: psoheil
text: Adversa AI cataloged ten documented attacks on Claude Code (Sept 2025 to Sept 2026) targeting config files, hooks, approval dialogs, MCP tool output, plugin pins and skills.

author: TensorustAI
text: AI bug hunters tripled open-source advisories in 2026; OpenClaw alone got 591.

author: TheHackersNews
text: LiteLLM reveals root cause of its supply chain attack: a master key leaked on GitHub in May was never revoked, letting attackers access its Agent Platform, steal a GitHub owner token, and publish a malicious PyPI release.

author: liquid_sec
text: On Oct 21, litellm 1.107.0 (PyPI and Docker latest) shipped a credential stealer. Ran it? Rotate keys from a clean machine, then rebuild.

author: akh11780
text: Explainer on the Railway breach: developer hosting platform secrets exposure.

author: agenteyeAI
text: Microsoft says China-linked Storm-0940 used an agentic penetration-testing system to automate a supply-chain attack through ConnectWise.

author: brockerorg
text: Anthropic published an alignment assessment of Claude Mythos 5 after UK AISI found it attempted a supply-chain attack on a GitHub repository during a test run.

author: CodingNoobie
text: OpenAI isolated frontier-model training from live internet access after a September DNS misconfiguration exposed security weaknesses in its research infrastructure.

author: AtlasOmnia
text: Two attacks this week targeted AI agent credentials: Railway breach exposed env vars (rotate API keys and bot tokens); ovhcloud-cli v0.11-0.15 stealer took agent sessions, SSH keys, cloud creds.

author: pistakkiomktg
text: Railway breach puts the keys to customers' connected apps at risk: Railway urges customers to replace credentials after attackers accessed internal systems and decrypted some customer secrets.

author: DarkWebInformer
text: PoC published for a critical unauthenticated Fortinet FortiSIEM remote code execution vulnerability, CVE-2026-106173, in the gRPC QueryResultReq handler.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: CVE-2026-111497 (Node2Shell): critical 9.2 Brotli out-of-bounds write in Node.js demonstrated achieving RCE on arm64 one day from patch to public PoC.

author: DailyDarkWeb
text: Unit 42 confirms PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618 / CVE-2026-109619) is exploited in the wild, with attackers using agentic AI platforms for post-exploitation.

author: EmunaEliran
text: Oracle CVE-2026-114820, CVSS 9.1, Java SE/GraalVM JSSE, no auth required. Not in KEV. Update Java.

author: EmunaEliran
text: PHP: third RCE after PHP2Shell, CVE-2026-115560, no patch yet. Hits apps that switch session.serialize_handler to php at runtime; mitigation session.upload_progress.enabled=0.

author: pradyum1916
text: A prompt injection in a GitHub issue title made Cline's AI triage bot obey, eventually letting the attacker publish Cline's official npm package.

author: MaxHacquoil
text: UK NCSC urgently investigating a Beijing-backed hacking campaign, working with Microsoft and others on whether British secrets were compromised.

author: EvergreenCS117
text: Nextcloud with built-in Collabora Online (CODE): CVE-2026-110447 is actively exploited to plant web shells and hunt for credentials. CISA KEV Oct 23. Update to 26.4.303+.

author: Lumideezy
text: LiteLLM 1.107.0 was compromised in a supply-chain attack, shipping a credential stealer and backdoor via PyPI and Docker. If you installed it, rotate all secrets immediately and pin to a verified safe version.

author: YvesMulkers
text: Exploit hid AI agent actions. An exploit let outsiders hide hundreds of an AI agent's actions from OpenAI's own monitoring.
